title: DashboardService.list_as_of — F-010 orchestration
scope: M-004 use case. Single class DashboardService with one public method list_as_of(as_of_date: date) → list[DashboardRow]. Composes DesignGradeMapRepository.list_active_all (T-060), LedgerAggregatesRepository.sum_deltas_by_source_type (T-059), and domain.stock.opening_balance + closing_balance (S2 T-045). Asserts the formula invariant opening + inward − outward + adjust == closing per row. Result ordered by design_name ASC, grade_code ASC.

success_criteria.manual: Seed 3 active pairs + a mix of inward/sale/adjustment ledger rows across June 2026. Call list_as_of(date(2026,6,30)) → exactly 3 DashboardRow with all 10 fields populated, sorted by design_name ASC then grade_code ASC, with opening + inward − outward + adjust == closing per row.
success_criteria.automated: All 11 TCs pass (TC-122 performance < 500ms p95 over 10 runs).
success_criteria.definition_of_done: Single class, single public method. Single DB round-trip for the aggregate (T-059) + O(N) latest_as_of lookups for opening/closing. AssertionError raised if invariant fails. NO direct SQL — composition only.

checkout_prompt: DashboardService.list_as_of implemented. Composes list_active_all + sum_deltas_by_source_type + opening/closing_balance, asserts the formula invariant, returns sorted DashboardRows. Ready for router wiring in T-064.
